_note: Real incidents the demo can replay. Dates, places, names and centers are from memory of public coverage: verify before pitching. 'start' is the real-world time that sim T+0 maps to (UTC). 'queries' are the names that identify the fire in posts ('Camp Fire' also matches #CampFire). 'center' [lat, lon] picks the nearby X accounts from news_sources.json; 'accounts' (handles) are always followed for this incident; 'posts' are X status URLs collected by URL on every refresh (one billed record each), the reliable way to get coverage of a past fire.
